svg.title: Studycall — Listener and Curio refinements
svg.desc: Three Listener variations explore balance, dialogue, and a pair of characters. Three Curio variations explore calmness, curiosity, and a playful wink. All use the original clay rose color.

svg.title: Studycall — Listener
svg.desc: Two warm, leaning shapes turn toward one another. Their shared curved opening suggests attentive conversation.

svg.title: Studycall — Listener / Close
svg.desc: Two related, gently leaning forms share a generous curved space. Matching curves give the original Listener mark a quiet, balanced rhythm.

g.text: Related curves. A quieter, balanced rhythm.

svg.title: Studycall — Listener / Close
svg.desc: Two related, gently leaning forms share a generous curved space. Matching curves give the original Listener mark a quiet, balanced rhythm.

svg.title: Studycall — Listener / Close

svg.title: Studycall — Listener / Call
svg.desc: A full voice and a smaller answering voice bend toward one another. Their offset, sculpted curves suggest a conversation opening up.

g.text: A full voice and a smaller answering voice.

svg.title: Studycall — Listener / Pair
svg.desc: The Listener shapes become two quiet characters looking toward each other. One small eye in each form adds warmth while preserving the simple silhouette.

g.text: A little character in each half.

svg.title: Studycall — Curio
svg.desc: A curious little thought with a swept crest, a tilted gaze, and a buoyant, asymmetric silhouette.

svg.title: Studycall — Curio Soft
svg.desc: A warm listening creature with a swept crest, an open gaze, and gently balanced feet. Its eyes are transparent cutouts.

g.text: A calm gaze and a gentler stance.

svg.title: Studycall — Curio Spark
svg.desc: An alert curious creature with one lifted crest, a buoyant stance, and an inquisitive gaze. Its eyes are transparent cutouts.

g.text: A lifted crest. A question on its mind.
